description:
The Wheels on the Bus: How Heavy Giant Wheels Spin So Fast! — The wheels on the bus go round and round! But how do heavy steel wheels roll so smooth without getting stuck?
Kids science answer for "wheels on the bus rhyme for kids" with fun 2D animation by BabyBeats Rhymo!

Inside every giant bus wheel, tiny steel ball bearings roll smoothly around a central axle, beating friction so heavy buses glide easily down the street.

BabyBeats Rhymo creates kid-safe 2D science cartoons and funny educational stories every day for curious US kids and families!
